Package chess.pieces

package chess.pieces
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Bishop
    A bishop: moves any number of squares diagonally.
    King
    A king: moves exactly one square in any direction.
    Knight
    A knight: moves in an "L" (two squares on one axis, one on the other) and may jump over any intervening pieces.
    Pawn
    A pawn: moves forward one square into an empty square, or two squares from its starting rank if both squares are empty, and captures one square diagonally forward.
    Piece
    Abstract base class for all six chess piece types.
    Queen
    A queen: combines rook and bishop movement.
    Rook
    A rook: moves any number of squares along a rank or file.
